name: explainer
label: Explainer (finance, business, science, tech)
description: A complex topic walked through step by step: faster cuts, on-screen text cards for key numbers.
_scenes: Explainers keep moving: shorter shots hold attention through the payoff.

stock._comment: B-roll hints: first matching line wins. Left side = words separated by | (whole-word match, case-insensitive).

llmGuidance: Explainer video (finance, business, science, tech). Show concrete, literal visuals for each idea: money, charts on screens, factories, labs, phones, people working. When the narration states a number, percentage or definition, a short spec_card (2-3 lines, max 5 words each) works well. Keep it moving: avoid the same visual twice in a row.
